install.iosAddHint: Scroll the list down a little if you do not see it.

permission.tryAgain: I turned it on, try again
permission.stillOff: It still looks off. Check the steps and try once more.
permission.next: Your phone will ask next. Choose Allow.

location.title: Share your location to check in
location.lead: Feelings looks at where you are only when you tap Check in or Check out.
location.r1: Confirms you are at the salon when you check in
location.r2: Only when you tap, never in the background
location.r3: Exact places are deleted after 90 days
location.deniedLead: Turn it back on in your phone's settings, then come back here.

iosSteps.2: Tap Privacy & Security, then Location Services.
iosSteps.3: Find Feelings and choose While Using the App.

androidSteps.1: Press and hold the Feelings icon, then tap App info.
androidSteps.3: Choose Allow only while using the app.

otherSteps.1: Open your browser's site settings for this page.

notifications.title: Get alerts on this phone
notifications.lead: Know straight away when something needs you or a request is answered.
notifications.r1: Approvals and replies show up as they happen
notifications.r2: Only things that matter, no marketing
notifications.r3: Turn them off any time in the app
notifications.deniedLead: Turn them back on in your phone's settings, then come back here.

androidSteps.1: Press and hold the Feelings icon, then tap App info.

otherSteps.1: Open your browser's site settings for this page.

notifications.installTitle: Open Feelings from your Home Screen
notifications.installLead: iPhone only sends alerts to the installed app. Open Feelings from its Home Screen icon, then turn alerts on.
notifications.unsupportedLead: Open Feelings in Chrome on Android or from the Home Screen on iPhone.

tour.welcomeBody: A quick look at what is where. It takes about 20 seconds.
tour.replayHint: A quick look at what each tab does

today.title: Today
today.body: Check in when you arrive and check out when you leave. Your phone asks for your location only then.

month.title: Your month
month.body: Every day with late minutes and overtime. Tap a day to see it or ask for a fix.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: Ask for leave or fix a missed check-in. The answer shows up here.

payslips.title: Payslips
payslips.body: Your pay for each month, once it is paid.

me.title: Me
me.body: Language, alerts and your data. You can replay this tour from here.

today.title: Today
today.body: Who is in, who is late and what needs your OK, at a glance.

actions.title: Needs action
actions.body: New phones, leave and fixes wait here for you to approve.

register.title: Register
register.body: The month grid for everyone. Tap a day to look closer or fix a mark.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Add people, send invites and open anyone's profile.

more.title: More
more.body: Payroll, credits, roster, roll-call and settings. You can replay this tour from here.

gate.title: Install Feelings to continue
gate.lead: Feelings runs as an app on your phone. Add it to your Home Screen, then open it from there.
gate.stays: This page stays until you open Feelings from the Home Screen.
gate.done: Installed. Open Feelings from your Home Screen to continue.
gate.androidLead: Tap Install. It takes a few seconds.
gate.android1Hint: The three dots at the top right of Chrome.
gate.android2Hint: Or Add to Home screen, then Install.
gate.android3Hint: Find the new icon on your Home Screen.
gate.openSafariHint: Only Safari can add Feelings to the Home Screen. Copy the link, open Safari and paste it.
gate.openChromeHint: This browser cannot install apps. Copy the link and open it in Chrome.

hint.text: Feelings is made for phones. Open this link on your phone to install it.
